POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JULY 27, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 2:00 PM

Sarah Bedy, Member  Leanna Noble, Member
Pam Chotiswatdi, Member  Patricia Scott, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Sarah Bedy called the meeting to order at 2:00 P.M.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Bedy, Noble, Chotiswatdi

  Commissioners Absent: Scott

Also present: Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager, Joseph Botelho, Community
Program Specialist V, Jennifer Santana, Community Program Specialist.

Roll call was taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55551  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Homeless Services
  Policy Subcommittee meeting of Monday, May 11, 2026.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Noble, Chotiswatdi
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Scott

2.  26-55552  Recommendation to review and approve a proposal for a $50,000 budget plan for
  the Mayor’s Fund pilot hygiene project and submit the proposal to the Mayor and
  City Council with funding provided through the Mayor’s Fund.

  A motion was made by Member Chotiswatdi, seconded by Member Noble, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3 Bedy, Noble, Chotiswatdi
  No:  0 None

  Page 1 of 3
   POLICY SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES
  MONDAY, JULY 27, 2026
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Scott

  • Chair Sarah Bedy requested that Homeless Service Bureau explore potential
  city-owned locations where the pilot program could be implemented.
  • Members of the subcommittee agreed that the language presented in the
  proposal was appropraite and recommended moving it forward for final
  approval by the full Homeless Services Advisory Committee.
  • Staff advised that the proposal will be drafted as a TFF memo
  recommendation to the Mayor and City Council once approved.

3.  26-55553  Recommendation to discuss strategies around engaging the public on Homeless
  Services Initiatives.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Noble, Chotiswatdi
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Scott

  • The subcommittee discussed strategies for community engagement related
  to upcoming homeless services projects. Members explored the idea of
  developing policies for the Homeless Services Advisory Committee to
  approve that would guide community outreach efforts. The goal is to educate
  community members about homelessness initiatives and new projects while
  providing opportunities to hear from individuals with lived experience who
  have experienced homelessness and are now receiving services and
  working toward stability.
  • Staff and the subcommittee discussed potential upcoming projects for which
  the committee could assist with community outreach. Staff will provide
  additional information regarding the projects and their timelines as more
  details become available.
  • Chair Sarah Bedy will draft a script that can be shared with the Homeless
  Services Advisory Committee meeting in August.

4.  26-55554  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Chotiswatdi, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Bedy, Noble, Chotiswatdi
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Scott

  • Member Pam requested a discussion regarding the need for specialized
  shelter options and additional data on shelter gaps for specific populations,
  including women, older adults, individuals with disabilities, and other
  vulnerable groups.
  • Staff advised that this topic could be explored within the context of the City of
  Long Beach and available local data; however, obtaining comparable data
  outside of Long Beach may be more challenging.
  • These items will be brought back for further discussion at the next Policy
  Subcommittee meeting in September.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

  • Chair Sarah Bedy adjourned the meeting at 3:01 p.m.
